name: Martial Animal
body:
The animal companion gains +1 attack and is considered to have Int 13 and Combat Expertise for prerequisites.

Prerequisites: Companion level 5th, Wis 13

Benefit(s): Your master has trained you to be able to fight in many extraordinary ways. You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with your natural attacks. Also, for the purposes of learning the feats Improved Bull Rush, Greater Bull Rush, Improved Grapple Greater Grapple, Improved Steal, Greater Steal, Improved Sunder, Greater Sunder, Improved Trip, and Greater Trip, this feat counts as having an Intelligence score of 13 and the feat Combat Expertise.
